# opstracer_user (Data Source)

Look up an org member by email, to get the user ID for schedules, teams and escalation policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

output "alice_id" {
  value = data.opstracer_user.alice.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email of the org member.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `id` (String) User ID.
- `role` (String) Org role, e.g. `OWNER`.
